title: 第七課：早上九點去 KTV
zh1:
安同：月美，妳要去哪裡？
月美：去 KTV 唱歌。我和朋友九點二十分在大安 KTV 見面。
安同：早上九點去 KTV？為什麼？
月美：從早上七點到中午十二點，最便宜。要不要一起去？
安同：我想去，可是我得去銀行。下次吧！
月美：好啊，下次你一定要來，我想聽你唱歌。
安同：沒問題。對了，什麼時候有空一起吃飯？
月美：後天我有空，你呢？
安同：我也有空，後天晚上七點怎麼樣？
月美：好啊！再見。
py1:
Āntóng：Yuèměi, nǐ yào qù nǎlǐ?
Yuèměi：Qù KTV chànggē. Wǒ hàn péngyou jiǔdiǎn èrshí fēn zài Dà’ān KTV jiànmiàn.
Āntóng：Zǎoshàng jiǔdiǎn qù KTV? Wèishénme?
Yuèměi：Cóng zǎoshàng qīdiǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn, zuì piányí. Yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
Āntóng：Wǒ xiǎng qù, kěshì wǒ děi qù yínháng. Xià cì ba!
Yuèměi：Hǎo a, xià cì nǐ yídìng yào lái, wǒ xiǎng tīng nǐ chànggē.
Āntóng：Méi wèntí. Duìle, shénme shíhou yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn?
Yuèměi：Hòutiān wǒ yǒu kòng, nǐ ne?
Āntóng：Wǒ yě yǒu kòng, hòutiān wǎnshàng qīdiǎn zěnmeyàng?
Yuèměi：Hǎo a! Zàijiàn.
en1:
Antong：Yuemei, where are you going?
Yuemei：To KTV to sing. My friends and I are meeting at Da’an KTV at 9:20.
Antong：Going to KTV at 9:00 in the morning? Why?
Yuemei：From 7:00 in the morning to noon, it is the least expensive. Do you want to come?
Antong：I would like to, but I have to go to the bank. Maybe next time.
Yuemei：Okay. You definitely have to come next time. I want to hear you sing.
Antong：No problem. By the way, when are you free to eat together?
Yuemei：I am free the day after tomorrow. How about you?
Antong：I am free too. How about 7:00 in the evening the day after tomorrow?
Yuemei：Great! See you.
zh2:
安同：如玉，妳在吃飯啊？
如玉：是，吃午餐，等一下要上課。你呢？
安同：我剛下課。對了，下午四點半學校有籃球比賽。妳想去看嗎？
如玉：想啊。比賽幾點結束？
安同：六點半。妳晚上有事嗎？
如玉：我最近很忙，每天晚上都上書法課。
安同：學得怎麼樣？
如玉：剛開始學，字寫得不好，可是我覺得很有意思。
安同：我有空可以去看看嗎？
如玉：我得問問老師。
py2:
Āntóng：Rúyù, nǐ zài chīfàn a?
Rúyù：Shì, chī wǔcān, děng yíxià yào shàngkè. Nǐ ne?
Āntóng：Wǒ gāng xiàkè. Duìle, xiàwǔ sìdiǎn bàn xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài. Nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
Rúyù：Xiǎng a. Bǐsài jǐdiǎn jiéshù?
Āntóng：Liùdiǎn bàn. Nǐ wǎnshàng yǒu shì ma?
Rúyù：Wǒ zuìjìn hěn máng, měitiān wǎnshàng dōu shàng shūfǎ kè.
Āntóng：Xué de zěnmeyàng?
Rúyù：Gāng kāishǐ xué, zì xiě de bù hǎo, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìsi.
Āntóng：Wǒ yǒu kòng kěyǐ qù kànkan ma?
Rúyù：Wǒ děi wènwen lǎoshī.
en2:
Antong：Ruyu, are you eating?
Ruyu：Yes, I am eating lunch. I have class in a bit. How about you?
Antong：I just got out of class. By the way, there is a basketball game at school at 4:30 this afternoon. Would you like to watch?
Ruyu：Yes. What time does the game end?
Antong：6:30. Are you busy this evening?
Ruyu：I have been busy lately. I go to calligraphy class every evening.
Antong：How is your studying going?
Ruyu：I just started. I do not write characters well, but I think it is interesting.
Antong：May I go check it out when I have time?
Ruyu：I have to ask the teacher.

act:
I. What Are They Doing?
【目標 Goal】Describe actions in progress and how well they are performed.
【做法 Task】In pairs, study the pictures and describe what each person is doing and how well they are doing it.
【例】他在寫書法。他寫得怎麼樣？

II. Daily Routines
【目標 Goal】None
【做法 Task】Complete Xiaoming’s daily schedule with 從…到… time or place phrases. Then tell a partner what you did yesterday morning, noon, afternoon, and evening, and report to the class.
【例】他從＿＿到＿＿有中文課。
他從＿＿到＿＿在教室。

III. Daily Activity Survey
【目標 Goal】Discuss habitual activities and precise times.
【做法 Task】Interview classmates to find who drinks coffee, studies Chinese, exercises, uses the internet, eats desserts, or watches movies every day, and record when they do it.
【例】你每天都運動嗎？你通常幾點運動？

IV. Scheduling an Appointment
【目標 Goal】None
【做法 Task】In pairs, write an appointment dialogue of no more than ten lines using 有空、最近、可以、在哪裡、什麼時候、幾點.
【例】A：你什麼時候有空？
B：這個週末。
A：我們幾點在哪裡見面？

V. Advertisements
【目標 Goal】None
【做法 Task】Describe the dragon boat team advertisement: applicants must swim and speak some Chinese; practice is daily from 6:30 to 9:00 a.m. in Xindian. Ask whether classmates are interested.
【例】龍舟隊每天早上六點半到九點在新店練習。你有興趣嗎？
cult:
臺灣最受歡迎的社交休閒活動——KTV
在臺灣，「唱 KTV」是不分老少、廣受歡迎的社交休閒活動。從傳統卡拉 OK 酒吧到連鎖 KTV 店，隨處可見唱歌的人潮。許多家庭也會安裝家用卡拉 OK，婚宴或大型聚會場所亦常設有點歌設備。

不論週末消遣、慶生派對或節慶聚會，KTV 都是常見選擇。現代連鎖 KTV 除了專業音響與燈光，也提供多樣餐點及冷熱飲料，讓顧客一邊用餐，一邊盡情歡唱。

gps.title: I. Time and Place of Events

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Time + Place + Event

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: When describing an event, Chinese follows the fixed order Time → Place → Action. The subject may precede or follow the time phrase.
blocks.ex:
他和朋友下午在教室寫書法。
He and his friend write calligraphy in the classroom in the afternoon.
我昨天晚上到我家附近的咖啡店喝咖啡。
I went to a café near my home for coffee last night.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: The two basic orders are Subject + Time + Place + Action and Time + Subject + Place + Action. With 去/來, the destination precedes the action.
blocks.ex:
我們這個週末去圖書館看書。
We are going to the library to read this weekend.
你們明天早上十一點到我家來吃牛肉麵。
Come to my home for beef noodles at 11 tomorrow morning.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Place 不 before the locative/directional phrase, not before the main action verb.
blocks.ex:
我晚上不在家吃飯。
I do not eat at home in the evening.
他們這個週末不去山上看風景。
They are not going to the mountains this weekend.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Ask about time with 幾點 or 什麼時候, while keeping time before place and action.
blocks.ex:
你朋友晚上幾點去 KTV 唱歌？
What time does your friend go to KTV in the evening?
他們什麼時候到花蓮看籃球比賽？
When will they go to Hualien to watch the game?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: In Taiwan speech, 去/來 + place + action and 到 + place + 去/來 + action have the same meaning, though the latter is less common.

gps.title: II. From A to B 從…到…

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 從 + A + 到 + B

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 從…到… expresses a spatial range from a starting point to an endpoint or a duration from a starting time to an ending time.
blocks.ex:
我從早上十點二十分到下午一點十分有中文課。
I have Chinese class from 10:20 a.m. to 1:10 p.m.
從我家到那個游泳池有一點遠。
It is a little far from my home to that pool.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Use 不是從 to reject an assumed starting point or range; other negative expressions may precede the whole 從…到… phrase.
blocks.ex:
我們的書法課不是從九點到十一點。
Our calligraphy class is not from nine to eleven.
從這棟大樓到那家 KTV 不遠。
It is not far from this building to that KTV.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: The 從…到… range can appear with 嗎, A-not-A, or a choice question.
blocks.ex:
你們老師後天從早上到下午都有空嗎？
Is your teacher free from morning to afternoon the day after tomorrow?
請問從圖書館到你們宿舍遠不遠？
Is it far from the library to your dorm?

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: S + 在 + Action Verb

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 在 before an action verb indicates that the action is in progress at that moment. It can also refer to an action in progress at a specified past time.
blocks.ex:
李老師在上課。
Teacher Li is teaching.
你看！陳先生在唱歌。
Look! Mr. Chen is singing.
昨天下午五點我在做飯。
I was cooking at five yesterday afternoon.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: For emphatic negation, 不是在 is more common than simply 不在.
blocks.ex:
他不是在看書，他在看籃球比賽。
He is not reading; he is watching a basketball game.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use a question word or 嗎 to ask about an action in progress.
blocks.ex:
你們在喝什麼？
What are you drinking?
他們在打籃球嗎？
Are they playing basketball?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: Progressive 在 can only be used before action verbs, not state verbs. For example, 手機在貴 is unacceptable.

gps.title: IV. Each and Every 每 měi

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 每 + M + N + 都 + VP

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 每 refers to every member of a group. 都 usually appears before the main verb to emphasize that there are no exceptions.
blocks.ex:
他妹妹每天都有空。
His younger sister is free every day.
他朋友每個週末都去學校附近的游泳池游泳。
His friend swims near school every weekend.

blocks.label: Total Negation
blocks.text: With 都 + 不/沒, every member or occasion is negated.
blocks.ex:
他每天都不忙。
He is not busy on any day.
我媽媽每個週末都沒空。
My mother is not free on any weekend.

blocks.label: Partial Negation
blocks.text: 不是每…都… means that the statement is not true every time or for every member.
blocks.ex:
他朋友不是每天都去看電影。
His friend does not go to the movies every day.
我們不是每天都有書法課。
We do not have calligraphy class every day.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 每天 and 每一天 mean the same thing; 一 is usually omitted. The same applies to 每個 and 每一個.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 可以 + VP

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 可以 expresses that someone has permission to perform an action.
blocks.ex:
我媽媽說，你們可以來我家打籃球。
My mother says you may come to my home to play basketball.
我叫馬安同，你可以叫我小馬。
My name is Ma Antong; you may call me Xiao Ma.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: 不可以 means that an action is not permitted or is prohibited; it cannot express impossibility.
blocks.ex:
你不可以在圖書館裡面吃東西。
You may not eat inside the library.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use 可不可以 or 可以嗎 to ask for permission. A short affirmative answer is 可以.
blocks.ex:
我可不可以去看你們的籃球比賽？
May I watch your basketball game?
這是你的書嗎？我可以看看嗎？
Is this your book? May I take a look?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: Earlier 可以 expressed possibility, as in 看電影可以學中文. Here it asks for or grants permission. In negative sentences, 不可以 only means prohibition.

qs.instruction: Describe the pictures using Time + Place + Event.
qs.prompt: 晚上／他們家附近的餐廳／吃晚飯
answer: 他和他哥哥晚上七點在他們家附近的餐廳吃晚飯。
他和他妹妹中午在圖書館上網。

qs.prompt: 下午／九樓的教室／寫書法
answer: 這三個學生下午在九樓的教室寫書法。
很多學生早上在學校打籃球。

qs.instruction: Describe the actions in progress using 在.
Complete the sentences using 每…都.
Complete using 可以／不可以／可不可以／可以嗎.
qs.prompt:
A：請問咖啡可以外帶嗎？
B：＿＿，外帶、內用都＿＿。

A：這杯烏龍茶是誰的？我＿＿？
B：＿＿，請喝！

A：請問我們＿＿在這裡打網球？
B：早上＿＿，可是晚上＿＿。

A：這個週末我們去你家看看，＿＿？
B：＿＿，我這個週末沒事。

A：我們可以在大教室裡面吃東西嗎？
B：＿＿，可是小教室可以。
